label: Two separate populated interpretations retain actual Mathlib empty/singleton membership
paraphrase: Two separate populated interpretations retain actual Mathlib empty/singleton membership. A nominalist-style profile has an existing located bearer, occupant N1 and reverse member-support, with all set representatives absent and unlocated. A forward-only profile has the bearer and both empty/singleton representatives existing and located, satisfies occupant N1 and positive member-to-set propagation, and explicitly violates reverse support. The empty-set interpretation has no mathematical members. These are scoped formal controls, not Field's complete nominalization or complete physical theories.
